title: Variational modeling adapted to the medium with gradient properties
summary: This study aims to develop a numerical homogenization method that can be applied to a heterogeneous stratified medium. Traditional scale transition methods are inadequate in capturing the essential gradient properties of some materials. Therefore, the focus of this work is to construct a homogenized model that considers the material property gradient. To achieve this, a two-step homogenization scheme is proposed.
